findings.description: Text line calculation must be decoupled from widget build to prevent layout flickering and re-entry loops.
findings.resolution: Use controller listener with TextPainter and hysteresis threshold.

findings.description: Spawning the chained overlay as a new ModalRoute causes software keyboard drop and visual stutter.
findings.resolution: Implement overlay in-page at Scaffold/Stack level with shared FocusNode.

findings.description: Writing chained relations before the seed document exists in Postgres triggers RLS 42501 Forbidden.
findings.resolution: Enforce strict sequential persistence: await createEntity() then createRelation().
